title: forecast.batch.completed
description: One event per finished forecasting batch run (nightly or on demand). Published by demand-forecast-service to the Kafka topic named after event_type (forecast.batch.completed), partition key = payload.run_id. Delivery is at-least-once: consumers de-duplicate on event_id. Consumed by the gateway BFF (Flow C live dashboard, contracts/openapi/analytics-realtime.md section 4.5).

run_id.description: Batch run id: BATCH- + run date (YYYYMMDD) + 2-digit sequence for that day, e.g. BATCH-20261015-01.

model_version.description: MLflow registered model name and version used for the batch, '<name>/<version>', e.g. demand_forecast/4.

granularity.description: Time bucket of the forecasts produced. Also the unit of horizon.

sku_count.description: Number of distinct canonical SKUs forecast in this run.

warehouse_count.description: Number of distinct canonical warehouses covered in this run.

horizon.description: Forecast horizon length in granularity periods (days when granularity is daily, months when monthly).

completed_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the batch finished writing its results.

status.description: SUCCESS = every SKU/warehouse forecast. PARTIAL = some failed; see message.

metrics.description: Optional summary accuracy metrics for the run.

duration_seconds.description: Optional total batch run time in seconds.

destination_mart.description: Optional table the results were written to, e.g. clickhouse.demand_forecast_history.

message.description: Optional one-line human-readable summary for the dashboard card.
